m2StorageComparison.interpretation: Isolated processes with identical seed, iterations and learned-table digest. RSS and elapsed time remain sensitive to allocation, GC and machine load. This does not solve the full-game table-size problem.

finalTurn.scope: An unmerged perfect-recall table with separate double-precision regret and average entries. This is not a lower bound on a compressed solution or another algorithm.

census.proof: At turn six, each of the two players remembers every revealed joint commitment prefix. Each counted prefix has a compatible private deal. There are at most eight played cards before turn six; the sixth-turn draw leaves at least one affordable card and one free lane slot. Passing and at least one placement are therefore legal. Hidden private histories add further distinctions.

coverage.scope: Monte Carlo visitation coverage, not strategic accuracy. Unvisited nontrivial decisions use the uniform fallback. Forced decisions need no learned choice.

repositoryReports.interpretation: Learned information-constrained deviations give a lower bound on exploitability. Failure to find a profitable deviation does not certify equilibrium. Confidence is simultaneous 95% for the frozen-policy Monte Carlo evaluations, not a bound on optimizer quality.

finalTurn.scope: An unmerged perfect-recall table with separate double-precision regret and average entries. This is not a lower bound on a compressed solution or another algorithm.

census.proof: At turn six, each of the two players remembers every revealed joint commitment prefix. Each counted prefix has a compatible private deal. There are at most eight played cards before turn six; the sixth-turn draw leaves at least one affordable card and one free lane slot. Passing and at least one placement are therefore legal. Hidden private histories add further distinctions.

coverage.scope: Monte Carlo visitation coverage, not strategic accuracy. Unvisited nontrivial decisions use the uniform fallback. Forced decisions need no learned choice.
